contentText:
The Garmin Fenix 9. | Image: Garmin

Garmin just took the wraps off its new line of rugged Fenix 9 smartwatches , with the base model featuring an OLED display with up to 3,000 nits of brightness, making it twice as bright as its predecessor. Starting at $999.99 for the 43mm case option, the Fenix 9 has 50 percent more RAM and an upgraded map engine, allowing for faster panning.

It also comes with a scratch-resistant sapphire lens, an increased 64GB of storage, and a bunch of new software-based features, like Garmin Epic.
